statement.p: A rectangle has one side of 9 cm. How fast is the area of the rectangle changing at the instant when the other side is 12 cm and increasing at 4 cm per minute? (Give units.)

static.solution:
9 cm and that the other (say, the height) is increasing at 4 cm/min when it is 12 cm.
Differentiating the equation A = wh with respect to t and treating the width w as constant, we have \frac{dA}{dt} = w\frac{dh}{dt} = 9\cdot4 = 36 \hbox{ cm}^2\hbox{/min}.
